name: @equin/plugin-packages-process-alive
description: Writer liveness by pid: isProcessAlive(pid) — kill(pid, 0), ESRCH dead, EPERM alive (another account's), anything else thrown — and isOrphanedTemp(name, pattern) / writerPidOf: a temp file whose name carries its writer's pid is orphaned exactly when that writer is gone, so a sweep never reaps a live writer's temp across a machine sleep the way an mtime-age grace does.
